blocks.text: The Flow Log Aggregations page for Microsegmentation in the Zscaler Admin Console provides insight into your organization's aggregated network flows. You can view flows within a specific time period (up to the last 14 days) and filter the flows by AppZone and further by the source and destination resource groups within that AppZone.
The Flow Log Aggregations page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of network flows that have occurred in your organization.
View, monitor, and analyze flows between resource groups.
Evaluate the frequency of similar network flows.
Take appropriate actions based on the data displayed on the page about the flows.

blocks.heading: About the Flow Log Aggregations Page

blocks.text: On the Flow Log Aggregations page (Data Explorer > Microsegmentation > Flow Log Aggregations), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the flows by AppZone.
Filter the time range up to the last 14 days.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Show or hide available columns.
Show or hide available filters.

Filter the flows by Source Resource Groups and Destination Resource Groups. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results. By default, no filters are applied.
See image.
View a list of all flows that are configured for your organization. For each admin, you can see:
Source: The hostname or IP address of the source resource.
Source Resource Groups: The resource groups to which the source resource belongs.
Destination: The hostname or IP address of the destination resource.
Destination Resource Groups: The resource groups to which the destination resource belongs.
Destination Port: The destination port.
Protocol: The protocol, either TCP or UDP.
Action: The policy action applied to the traffic (e.g., Allow, Block, Sim Block).
Policy: The name of the policy.
Count: The number of flows observed.
